`ReceiptRecommendation` (`components/receipt/types.ts:2-8`) reads: `sponsor`, `description`, `resourceUrl`, `method` (defaults `'GET'`). `bazaarId` declared, never read.

### Declared in the renderer's own type but NEVER read (dead type surface)
`status` (:50), `payment.details.success`, `payment.details.payer`, `payment.details.requirements.asset`, `.payTo`, `.extra.feePayer` (:71-74), `session.sessionId`, `session.sessionToken`, `session.state` (:82,83,86), `requirements` (:88), `_recommendations_hint` (:91), and on `SessionFunding`: `amountAtomic`, `reference` (:40,46).

### Fields the SERVER emits that the renderer DROPS — this is the big one

**`open-mcp-server.mjs` never emits `recommendations`, and never emits `mode: 'session_required'`.** The modes it actually emits:

| Mode | Emitted at | Fields dropped | What the widget actually shows |
|---|---|---|---|
| `vault_required` | `:508-536` (also `:873`, `:888`, `:922`) | `enroll_url`, `pairing_url`, `pairing_ttl_seconds`, `next_action`, `next_tool`, `vault_status`, `user_bound`, `retry{}`, `message`, `instructions`, `reason`, `requirements`, `merchantSettlement` | no `error`, no `data` → **"No payload returned."** The onboarding link is invisible. |
| `vault_not_activated` | `:671-697` | `address`, `solanaAddress`, `activate_url`, `vault{vaultPda,swigAddress,receiveAddress,isActivated}`, `balances.usdc`, `retry`, `message`, `instructions`, `reason` | **"No payload returned."** |
| `vault_payment_unconfirmed` | `:765-776`, `:828-839` | `retryable:false`, `reason`, `message` ("Do NOT retry — re-running could pay twice"), `vault` | `payment.settled` is the **string** `'unknown'` (truthy) but `details` is the raw body without `.transaction`, so no stamp; body renders; the double-spend warning is **silently discarded** |
| `vault_error` | `:790-798`, `:858-866` | `message` (human copy), `requirements`, `paySource` | `ReceiptError` prints only the machine code, e.g. `anon_fetch_failed` |
| `vault_ready` / `vault_no_payment_required` | `:778-788`, `:841-850` | `vault`, `paySource` | correct — stamp + body |
| `tabOffer` (appended to success) | `lib/rail-tab-offer.mjs:164`, block built at `:71-93` | `mode`, `seller`, `perUnitAtomic`, `consent_url`, `message`, `instructions` | entirely invisible |
| `tab_available` (replaces response) | `lib/rail-tab-offer.mjs:98-117` | `consent_url`, `seller`, `perUnitAtomic`, `retry`, `message`, `instructions` | no `error`/`data` → **"No payload returned."** |
| `tab_pending` | `lib/rail-tab-offer.mjs:121-135` | `retryable`, `seller`, `retry`, `message`, `instructions` | **"No payload returned."** |
| `session_ready` (x402_access) | `:1002-1011` | `requirements`, `sessionResolution` | correct — body + access proof |
| `session_error` (x402_access) | `:984-996`, `:1013-1019` | `message`, `hint`, `details`, `sessionResolution` | raw code only |
| tool-level throw | `:1752`, `:1709` | — | `{status, error, url, method}` → `ReceiptError` |

`payment.details` on the vault path is built by `buildPaymentDetails` (`open-mcp-server.mjs:245-255`): it spreads the facilitator settlement object, always adds `settlementMs` (full open-mcp roundtrip), and adds `settleDurationMs` only when `settlement.extensions['dexter-timing'].settleDurationMs` is a number.

### Second producer — different shape
`toolsets/x402-client/index.mjs:239-258` (authenticated dexter-mcp toolset) emits `{ status, data, payment, error?, recommendations, _recommendations_hint }`. Notes:
- **No `url` / `method`** → `deriveResourceLabel` falls back to the literal string `"this endpoint"` (entry:106) and the method chip never renders.
- This is the **only** producer of `recommendations` (`:254`, from `getSponsoredRecommendations(response)` or `data._x402_sponsored`), so the Instinct card only ever appears on the authenticated toolset.
- Its `payment.details` (`normalizePaymentReceipt`, `:119-144`) has no `settleDurationMs` / `settlementMs` → the stamp renders with **no settle line**, and `transaction` may be `null` → no stamp at all despite `settled: true`.

### `sessionToken` `_meta` side-channel
Server side, all three tools do the same move: `open-mcp-server.mjs:1701-1705` (pay), `:1744-1748` (fetch), `:1841-1845` (access) — lift `result.session.sessionToken` out of `structuredContent` into `_meta.sessionToken` so the model never sees the bearer credential, and return the stripped session object in `structuredContent`.

Widget side, the hook exists: `useToolResponseMetadata` (`sdk/adapter.ts:121-135`) — ChatGPT reads `window.openai.toolResponseMetadata`, MCP-Apps hosts read `_meta` off the `ui/notifications/tool-result` notification (`:45-52`), and it returns `null` on hosts that strip `_meta`.

**This renderer never calls it.** The token is transmitted and unused. (Contrast `entries/x402-wallet.tsx:6,25-27`, which does consume `_meta` for `dexterCardToken` / `dexterWalletToken`.) Consequence: the funding panel's retry (`SessionFunding.tsx:117-120`) fires `callTool('x402_fetch', { url, method })` with **no** `sessionToken`, so it can only ever resume the session that the server resolves from the MCP session id — it cannot re-arm a token-scoped one.

### Against the wallet bar (`styles/widgets/wallet.css:7-29`, the reference)
Wallet declares literals on `.dxw-root`: `--page #F1EEE8`, `--paper #FFFDF9`, `--ink #1D1710`, `--ink-2 #6F6659`, `--ink-3 #A39784`, `--hair rgba(61,50,39,.10)`, `--ember #F2681A`, `--gold #CBAD72`; `max-width: 390px`, `border-radius: 24px`, 3-layer shadow (`:32-46`), `"Inter Display"` for headings (`:106,139,342,403`), `"JetBrains Mono"` + `tabular-nums` for money (`:29,56,85,120,137`), and a `:where()` button reset (`:25-28`).

bugs:
**B1 — `--foreground` is defined nowhere; the entire ink ramp silently falls back.** `x402-fetch-result.css:19-22` reads `var(--foreground, #1c1106)`. Verified: no `--foreground` in `src/styles/*.css`, none in `@openai/apps-sdk-ui`, and `grep -o -- "--foreground:[^;]*"` on the built bundle `public/apps-sdk/assets/sdk-zENMbHQ0.css` returns **nothing**. So `--ink` is always `#1c1106` (near-black brown), in both themes, and never responds to the theme flip.

**B2 — dark theme renders near-black ink on a dark slate "paper".** `--paper: var(--surface, #fefcf6)` (`css:17`) — but `base.css:117` defines `--surface: var(--dx-bg)`, and `--dx-bg` is `rgba(15,23,42,.68)` in dark (`base.css:60`), `rgba(255,255,255,.92)` in light (`:139,163`). The cream `#fefcf6` fallback is unreachable. Combined with B1: dark theme = `#1c1106` text on dark slate. Light theme happens to work. The entry actively sets `data-theme` on `documentElement` (entry:137-139), so the widget honors a dark host and then renders unreadable.

**B3 — the funding panel's CSS variables are out of scope; the panel renders completely unstyled.** All of `--paper`, `--paper-deep`, `--ink`, `--ink-soft`, `--ink-quiet`, `--rule`, `--orange` are declared on `.dx-receipt` (`css:16-26`). `.dx-receipt-funding` (`css:530`) is a **sibling** of `.dx-receipt`, not a descendant — entry:216-224 renders either `SessionFundingPanel` **or** the `<article className="dx-receipt">`. Undefined custom properties make each referencing declaration invalid at computed-value time: `background` → transparent, `box-shadow` → none, `border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--rule)` → none, the orange eyebrow/headline colors → inherited. Every `.dx-receipt-funding__*` rule that touches a token is dead.

**B4 — the funding panel is unreachable code.** Its only trigger is `mode === 'session_required'` (entry:170). Repo-wide, that string is produced at exactly one site: `lib/open-session-resolution.mjs:260`, inside `resolveSessionForPayment`. That function is exported (`:301`) and **never imported by any caller** — `open-mcp-server.mjs` uses `resolveOrCreateSessionForWallet` (`:941`) only. So `SessionFunding.tsx` (227 lines), `FundingCountdown`, the QR, the Solana Pay button, the "I've funded it — try again" retry, and ~180 lines of CSS are all dead today. (B3 means that if it were ever revived it would render naked.)

**B5 — the most common first-run state renders an empty receipt.** `vault_required` (`open-mcp-server.mjs:508-536`) carries no `error` and no `data`. Renderer: `isSession` false (mode mismatch), `isError` false (`!!toolOutput.error` is false, entry:171) → falls into the success branch → `ReceiptBody` with `data === undefined` → **"No payload returned."** (`ReceiptBody.tsx:32-38`), no stamp, no `enroll_url`, no `message`. A user with no wallet yet sees a blank receipt. Identical failure for `vault_not_activated` (`:671-697`), `tab_available` (`lib/rail-tab-offer.mjs:98-117`), `tab_pending` (`:121-135`). Compare `entries/x402-wallet.tsx:35-60`, which handles both `vault_required` and `vault_not_activated` explicitly with `SimpleState` — the wallet widget already solved this and the receipt never adopted it.

**B6 — the double-spend warning is discarded.** `vault_payment_unconfirmed` (`open-mcp-server.mjs:765-776`, `:828-839`) sets `payment.settled = 'unknown'` — a **truthy string**, so `payment?.settled` passes at entry:179 — but `details` is the raw `anonBody.payment` (not `buildPaymentDetails`), so `details.transaction` is absent and the stamp is skipped. There is no `error` field either. Net: the widget shows the body as if nothing happened, and the field that says *"The payment was dispatched and may have settled. Do NOT retry — re-running could pay twice"* never reaches the screen. The `settled` type is declared `boolean` at entry:60, which the server contradicts.

**B7 — error states show machine codes, not the human copy.** `ReceiptError` prints `toolOutput.error` (entry:235). On `vault_error` that is `anonBody?.error || 'anon_fetch_failed'` (`:861`) while the human sentence sits unread in `message` (`:862`). Same on `session_error` (`:987` code vs `:988` message vs `:989` hint).

**B8 — `:global()` is invalid plain CSS and kills the whole rule.** `x402-fetch-result.css:210-214`:
```css
.dx-receipt-body--json :global(.dx-json-viewer),
.dx-receipt-body--json [class*='JsonViewer'],
.dx-receipt-body--json pre { background: transparent !important; }
```
`:global()` is a CSS-Modules construct; this project uses plain global CSS (verified — `:global(.dx-json-viewer)` survives verbatim into the built `public/apps-sdk/assets/x402-fetch-result-Bkdhw5TH.css`). One invalid selector in a selector list invalidates the **entire** rule, so the `pre` branch never applies either. Also `.dx-json-viewer` and `JsonViewer` are not classes `JsonViewer.tsx` ever emits — it emits Tailwind utilities. The JSON block's `bg-surface-secondary` is never neutralized.

**B9 — intrinsic height is never reported when the first render is the loading state.** `useIntrinsicHeight` runs its effect once with `[]` deps and bails on `if (!el …) return;` (`components/x402/useIntrinsicHeight.ts:12-15`). The loading branch (entry:162-168) returns a div **without** `ref={containerRef}`, so at effect time `ref.current` is `null`, the ResizeObserver is never attached, and the effect never re-runs. On MCP-Apps hosts (Claude, Cursor) `_mcpToolOutput` starts `null` and is filled by a later notification (`sdk/adapter.ts:30,45-52`), so the first render is **always** the loading state → height reporting is permanently dead there. On ChatGPT it depends on whether `window.openai.toolOutput` is set before mount.

**B10 — content taller than `maxHeight` is clipped with no scroll.** `maxHeight` is applied inline (entry:214) but `.dx-fetch-result-frame` (`css:711-718`) sets no `overflow`. The only scroller in the tree is `JsonViewer`'s `max-h-96 overflow-y-auto` (`JsonViewer.tsx:149`). A long text response (6c) or a tall image (6b) overflows the clamp.

**B11 — two unrelated size thresholds fight each other.** The fullscreen toggle appears at `>500` chars (entry:155); the JSON Collapse/Expand appears at `>300` (`JsonViewer.tsx:122`). A 400-char JSON response gets a collapse control but **no** way to expand the widget; the `isLargePayload` probe also runs `JSON.stringify` on `data` regardless of whether the body will render as image or text.

**B12 — `getExplorerUrl` chain matching is substring-based and misroutes.** `components/x402/format.ts:29-40` tests `network?.includes('137')`, `.includes('10')`, `.includes('56')`, etc. `'eip155:1370'`, `'eip155:100'`, and any CAIP-2 string containing those digits match the wrong explorer; the Optimism case is the only one that guards with a second `includes('eip155')`. Default fallback is Solscan, so an unknown EVM chain links to a Solana explorer.

**B13 — stale/contradicted comments.** `SessionFunding.tsx:5-8` states *"the open-mcp side auto-bootstraps a session whenever a paid call hits without one, so this widget always receives a populated `funding` object"* — false; open-mcp never emits `session_required` at all (B4), and the vault path is non-custodial with no session funding by design (`open-mcp-server.mjs:625-627`). `ReceiptHeader.tsx:32` hardcodes the eyebrow `"Dexter · Receipt"` even when the payload is an `x402_access` identity proof (`ACCESS_META`, `open-mcp-server.mjs:139`), where nothing was paid.

**B14 — `onAct` arity mismatch (harmless today, a trap on restyle).** `InstinctNextCall` calls `onAct(recommendation.resourceUrl, method)` (`:67`) against a declared `(url: string, method: string) => void` (`:18`), but the entry passes `(url) => openExternal(url)` (entry:249) — the method is silently dropped. The CTA therefore only ever opens the URL in a browser; it never re-invokes `x402_fetch` for a POST recommendation.
must_preserve:
**Host-height contract.** The outer element must keep `ref={containerRef}` from `useIntrinsicHeight` (entry:135, 212) and stay a normal in-flow block that grows with content — `useIntrinsicHeight.ts:17` reports `el.scrollHeight` through `window.openai.notifyIntrinsicHeight` on every ResizeObserver tick. Do not make the frame `position: fixed`, `height: 100%`, or `overflow: hidden` at the top level, or the reported height lies. (Fixing B9 means attaching the ref in the loading branch too, or moving the effect off `[]` deps.)

**maxHeight clamp.** `style={{ maxHeight: isFullscreen ? undefined : maxHeight ?? undefined }}` (entry:214) — the host-supplied inline cap, dropped only in fullscreen. Keep the inline-style seam; don't move it to CSS.

**Theme dual-write.** `document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', theme)` (entry:137-139) **and** `data-theme={theme}` on the frame (entry:211). `base.css` keys light mode off `:root[data-theme="light"]` (`:161`) and `@media (prefers-color-scheme: light) :root:not([data-theme="dark"])` (`:136-137`). Any new token scheme must resolve in both.

**Display-mode toggle.** `requestDisplayMode?.({ mode: … })` wrapped in try/catch → `captureWidgetException(error, { phase: 'request_display_mode' })` (entry:143-149). The hook may be absent on non-ChatGPT hosts.

**Host-mediated navigation only.** Every outbound link goes through `openExternal` from `useAdaptiveOpenExternal` (`sdk/adapter.ts:193-201` — `mcpApps.openLink` on MCP-Apps hosts, `window.openai.openExternal({href})` on ChatGPT). Call sites: explorer (`ReceiptStamp.tsx:38-40`, both the seal and the "View on solscan.io" button), Instinct CTA (entry:249), Solana Pay + funding page (`SessionFunding.tsx:191,200`). **Never convert these to `<a href>`** — the iframe is sandboxed and `solana:` scheme URLs in particular are validated with `new URL()` and logged before dispatch (`SessionFunding.tsx:135-156`).

**In-widget tool call.** `callTool('x402_fetch', { url, method })` (`SessionFunding.tsx:117-120`) via `useCallToolFn` (`sdk/use-call-tool.ts:61-68`, throws when `window.openai.callTool` is missing). Must keep: disabled + `aria-busy` while in flight (`:213-214`), inline `role="alert"` error on throw (`:219`), and no polling/timers (the header comment at `:16-19` makes user-initiated-only an explicit rule).

**Telemetry.** `logWidgetEvent` fires on funding mount, every button tap, openExternal success/throw, and retry resolve/throw (`SessionFunding.tsx:90-103,115,121,129,145,148,152,155`). The buffer is module-level, capped at 24 (`widgetLog.ts:25-26,41`), and mirrored to console. `DebugPanel` consumes it as `extraInfo={getWidgetLogForDebug()}` (entry:257). Keep the DebugPanel mounted in every state and keep `data-widget-build` on the root (entry:264 → `DebugPanel.tsx:31`).

**CSP — no new hosts.** `apps-sdk/register.mjs:83-159` builds the frozen CSP (it freezes at the OpenAI submission scan; see the comment at `:74-78`). Images this widget currently loads: `https://api.dexter.cash/api/img?url=…` (`ReceiptBody.tsx:27-29`), `https://api.qrserver.com/v1/create-qr-code/…` (`SessionFunding.tsx:83-84`), `https://dexter.cash/assets/pokedexter/dexter-logo.svg` (`DexterLoading.tsx:3`), `https://dexter.cash/assets/chains/*.svg` (`ChainIcon.tsx:18`). **There is no font CDN in `connect_domains` or `resource_domains`, and no `@font-face` anywhere** — so `Inter`, `Inter Display`, `IBM Plex Mono`, and `JetBrains Mono` are host-resolved or they fall back. Any restyle must be legible in the fallback stack, and must not add a webfont link.

**Image proxy rule.** Third-party response images route through `api.dexter.cash/api/img` (`ReceiptBody.tsx:27-29`) precisely so arbitrary seller CDNs don't need CSP entries. Keep that indirection.

**Global class names.** Nothing here is CSS-module scoped; `dx-receipt*`, `dx-instinct-next*`, `dx-fetch-result-frame` are global. If you namespace them under a root class (the `.dxw-` pattern), every selector in the 739-line sheet and every `className` string in the 7 receipt components has to move together — and fixing B3 requires the token block to live on an ancestor that covers **both** the funding panel and the receipt article.

**Shared components — blast radius.** `DexterLoading` is also used by `x402-marketplace-search` and `passkey-onboard` (`DexterLoading.tsx:36-40`); `JsonViewer`, `DebugPanel`, `useIntrinsicHeight`, `format.ts`, `ChainIcon` are re-exported from `components/x402/index.ts` and consumed by other entries. Restyle them in place only if you intend the change everywhere; otherwise fork a receipt-local variant.

**Mount id and build.** `#x402-fetch-result-root` (html:8, entry:262). Build config `apps-sdk/vite.config.ts`. The `ui://` URI is a sha1 of the built html (`apps-sdk/widget-uris.mjs:9-21`), so a rebuild bumps the resource URI automatically — no manual version step, but the server must be restarted to re-hash.
notes:
**Payload matrix, so the designer doesn't have to reverse-engineer it.** Two servers, one widget. Real payloads to design against:

*A. Paid success, open-mcp (`vault_ready`):* `{status:200, mode:'vault_ready', url, method, data:{…}, payment:{settled:true, details:{transaction, network:'solana:5eykt…', settlementMs:1840, settleDurationMs:412, requirements:{amount:'20000', extra:{decimals:6}}}}, vault:{…}, paySource:'anon_vault'}` → header + body + **PAID / $0.02 / 412ms / Solana** stamp.

*B. Paid success, authenticated toolset:* `{status:200, data:{…}, payment:{settled:true, details:{transaction, network:'eip155:8453', requirements:{amount:'50000', extra:{…}}}}, recommendations:[…]}` → **no url/method** → title reads "this endpoint", no method chip, stamp with **no settle line**, plus the Instinct card. This is the only path that ever shows Instinct.

*C. No wallet yet (`vault_required`) — the single most common state:* currently an empty receipt (B5). It carries `enroll_url`, `message`, `instructions`, `retry`. This is where the design work matters most; `entries/x402-wallet.tsx:35-45` already has the approved treatment (`SimpleState` — title, body, one CTA).

*D. Wallet not activated:* same empty-receipt failure, carries `activate_url`, `balances.usdc`, `message`.

*E. Free / non-402 endpoint:* `{status:200, data}` from `open-mcp-server.mjs:903` — no `payment`, no `mode` → body only, no stamp. Also `vault_no_payment_required` (`:780,843`) with `payment:{settled:false}`.

*F. Identity-gated (`x402_access` → `session_ready`):* `{status, mode:'session_ready', data, auth:{mode:'siwx', network, signedAddress}, requirements, session, sessionFunding}` → body + **PROVEN / SIWX / Solana** stamp. Note the header still says "Dexter · Receipt" though nothing was paid (B13).

*G. Running-tab offer:* success + `tabOffer` (invisible today), or the offer-as-response `tab_available` / `tab_pending` (empty receipt today). See `lib/rail-tab-offer.mjs`.

**Three thresholds worth designing around, not just inheriting:** 500 chars → fullscreen toggle (entry:155); 300 chars → JSON collapse (`JsonViewer.tsx:122`); `depth < 2` → JSON auto-expand (`JsonViewer.tsx:34`). The 384px (`max-h-96`) JSON scroll box applies even in fullscreen, so "expand" currently buys padding and a taller frame but the same small scroller — probably the wrong behavior.

**The JSON block is the biggest single visual liability.** It is a VS Code dark-theme tree (`#9cdcfe` keys, `#e9967a` strings) inside a `rounded-xl bg-surface-secondary` card, sitting on cream paper, with a "RESPONSE PAYLOAD" header the receipt never asked for. Since `data` is arbitrary seller JSON, this renders on most successful calls. The CSS already tried and failed to neutralize it (B8). A paper-native JSON treatment — ink-toned syntax, hairline rules instead of a card, mono at the receipt's scale — is probably the highest-leverage change after the missing states.

**Precedent to copy, not invent:** `apps-sdk/design-reference/wallet-widget-B-calm-home-sheets.*` is cited as the approved spec at `styles/widgets/wallet.css:3`. `components/wallet/Sheet.tsx` + `SimpleState.tsx` are the reusable bottom-sheet and one-CTA-state primitives; `components/wallet/format.ts` has the money formatting. If the receipt adopts them, it also inherits the wallet's literal token block and dodges B1/B2 entirely.

**Money formatting differs between the two widgets.** `components/x402/format.ts:16-21` (`formatUsdc`): `<$0.01` → 4dp, `<$1` → 3dp, else 2dp — used for the stamp amount. The wallet has its own `components/wallet/format.ts`. Two USDC formatters is drift; worth unifying while the file is open.

**Suggested order of attack:** (1) own the tokens locally, kill the `--surface`/`--foreground` dependency (B1, B2, B3); (2) build the missing states — `vault_required`, `vault_not_activated`, `vault_payment_unconfirmed`, tab offers — reusing `SimpleState` (B5, B6); (3) show `message` instead of the raw error code (B7); (4) re-skin the JSON body (B8); (5) attach the height ref in the loading branch (B9). Items 2, 3, and 6 (`onAct` arity, B14) are behavior changes, not restyles — flag them to Branch before shipping, since #95 is scoped as a restyle.

**Not verified — no live render.** Everything above is read from source; I did not build or screenshot the widget. B2, B3, B8, and B9 are strong static reads (B1/B2/B8 confirmed against the *built* bundle in `public/apps-sdk/assets/`), but a browser render would settle B9's ChatGPT-vs-MCP-Apps timing question definitively.
